overview: A YouTube-style video app where people browse a trending feed, watch videos with autoplay, upload their own clips, follow creators, and manage a profile with coins.
features: Four-tab bottom navigation: Home, Trending, Upload, Profile
Home feed of video cards with thumbnails, titles, creators and view counts
Trending list ranked by views with viral game and entertainment clips
Full-screen player with autoplay, unmute control, like and save
Upload videos with a title and description
Follow creators and see follower counts
Profile with avatar upload, display name editing, own videos and saved videos
Buy coin packs with a card and track your coin balance
